# Draft:Roco Kingdom (game)

----
Roco Kingdom is a Chinese online video game franchise and community themed around a magical kingdom primarily targeted at children aged 7 to 14. It is developed by Morefun Studios, published by Tencent Games, and runs on Adobe Flash. Public testing began on July 15, 2010. In April 2015, the number of registered players surpassed 200 million. A mobile version called Roco Kingdom: World entered closed beta in August 2024. The franchise has inspired a number of animated films and TV shows.
Background
According to the plot setting of the game, the Kingdom of Rocos is located inside a basin close to the sea. The Rocos have lived there along with a variety of other creatures since prehistoric times. The Rocos rule their land through magic and have specialized into merchants, detectives, gardeners, explorers, and knights. They interact regularly with magical creatures and items.
Elements of the game
In addition to assigned quests, players can engage in mini-games such as playing music on a virtual keyboard and trivia quizzes. They can also initiate battles with their pets similar to fighting with Pokémons. In-game design began transitioning into an open world model in 2023.

|One of the main characters, Kelisya, is a friend of Fielt. Her pet is Dimo.

|Fielt
|One of the main characters, a friend of Locke. Her pets are Shuilanlan and Baoliyuan.

|Kelisya
|One of the main characters, Princess, is the youngest and most beloved daughter of the king in Rock Kingdom. She is compassionate and enjoys going on adventures with young Locke. Her father is often absent, so she spends time with her pets, Daixiaolu and Huohua, laughing and growing, sometimes joyfully and sometimes with sadness.
|-
|St. Andrew
|The current king of Rock Kingdom, King Arthur, inherited his father's legacy and leads young Locke in the fight against Enzo's dark magic forces. He enjoys going incognito, traveling around the kingdom to understand the people's lives and concerns.
|-
|Maxwell
|The Minister of State of the Kingdom is rigorous and meticulous, and is the king's proud assistant.
|-
|Griffin
|The current headmaster of the Rock Kingdom Magic Academy, Headmaster Griffin, is deeply devoted to teaching. He hopes to find a gifted young Locke to train into a powerful wizard capable of combating Enzo's dark magic and saving the kingdom in times of crisis. In the mission "Embodiment of the Nightmare", he was absorbed by a nightmare and lost his dark thoughts, resulting in the creation of a younger version of Headmaster Griffin.
|-
|Rulhelli
|The great magician of the kingdom.
|-
|Enzo
|The strongest villain in Roco Kingdom, Enzo, is a nightmarish presence. He was once the most favored student of Headmaster Griffin (and also his adopted son), and he served as the 13th Chief Magician of Rock Kingdom. In the game, Enzo often appears in a ghostly form.
|-
|Lina
|After the destruction of the "Sky Tower", a character with a dark persona known as Dark Madonna appears. She is a spiritual maiden from the heavens who arrived in "Roco Kingdom" in September 2014. In 2015, she returned to the heavens to protect Locke and Maui. Her pet is Amy.
|-
|Dark Lina
|Lina's dark personality, known as Dark Lina, is a villain in Roco Kingdom.
|-
|Nightmare
|In the mission "Embodiment of the Nightmare", Headmaster Griffin was absorbed by a nightmare and lost his dark thoughts. However, it is important to note that the nightmare and Griffin are not the same entity.
|-
|Lulu
|The owl that is the player's companion.
|}
Related works
Characters and elements from other brands and franchises, such as Cardcaptor Sakura, Digimon, and Sanrio, appear in Roco Kingdom during certain events.
Films
* Roco Kingdom: Sacred Dragon Knight: Directed by Yu Shengjun, produced by Tencent, Youyang Media, and XuanDong Animation, premiered on September 30, 2011.
* Roco Kingdom: The Desire of Dragon: Directed by Yu Shengjun, produced by Tencent and Youyang Media, premiered on January 31, 2013.The film earned 32 million RMB in its opening week.
* ''Roco Kingdom 3: The Sacred Dragon's Guardian: Premiered on July 10, 2014.
* Roco Kingdom 4: Departure! Valley of Giants: Released on August 13, 2015.
Cartoons
Network animation
* Roco Kingdom: Martial Arts Tournament: Tells the story of Rocky and his friends participating in the Roco Kingdom Martial Arts Tournament, premiered on July 13, 2012.
* Roco Kingdom: Adventure on Xuan Yu Island: One day, a mysterious event occurs in the peaceful Roco Kingdom. Three mysterious pets appear on Xuan Yu Island, and brave Rocky sets off alone on an adventure to uncover the truth. Released in 2013.
* Roco Kingdom: The Triumph of Light: Rocky, Dimo, and Princess Keri face trials and open the gates of the Sacred Temple of Light. However, they find themselves in a black-and-white world, where everything—including the ground, sky, and even the pets—has turned into white stones. Released during the 2013 anniversary celebration.
* Roco Kingdom: The Legend of Resurrection: Rocky and his friends discover a mysterious resurrection scroll in the Crystal Cavern. The scroll states that finding three magical artifacts will allow the resurrection of any life form, but the scroll is stolen by Enzo. To prevent Enzo from using it to awaken powerful demons and attack the kingdom, the young heroes decide to take action to stop his evil plot.
* Roco Kingdom: Divine Pet Chronicles: A compilation of the above four animated films, premiered on November 25, 2014.
TV animation
* Roco Kingdom Adventure: It tells the story of Locke and his friends studying at the Magic Academy in Roco Kingdom. It premiered in August 2013.
* Roco Kingdom Adventure 2: Enzo's Diary: The sequel to Roco Kingdom Adventure, it premiered in April 2014.
* Roco Kingdom Adventure 3: The Eight Great Medals: It follows Locke and his friends as they gradually grow and obtain the Eight Great Medals. It premiered in June 2015.
* Roco Kingdom Adventure 4: The Undersea Maze: No specific information is available yet, including the title, plot, or release date.
Live-action TV series
* Roco Kingdom Magic Academy: The Mysterious Melody: A Chinese live-action TV series, it began airing every Friday on Hunan Golden Eagle Cartoon TV starting from June 13, 2014.
Musicals
* Roco Kingdom Adventure'': Produced by the Beijing Children's Art Theatre, it was performed from May 31 to June 2, 2013. It was performed at the Great Hall of the People on June 1, 2014.
Reception
In 2012 Roco Kingdom: Martial Arts Tournament received the China Animation & Comic Competition Golden Dragon Award for best screenplay in the category of animations.
In 2015 Roco Kingdom 4 broke sales records in China for domestically produced animated films.
